title: ValueFlow: Measuring the Propagation of Value Perturbations in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating value drift and alignment in multi-agent LLM systems by injecting prompt-level perturbations for 56 human value dimensions (based on the Schwartz Value Survey). The paper measures both agent-level and system-level susceptibility to these value shifts using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on generated Yes-No questions.
